source_refs.note: Control of Posterior Pituitary: a main subheading of 16.2.1 Neurosecretory Role of Hypothalamus, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 60-60.

blocks.text: Do hormones, oxytocin aur antidiuretic hormone (ADH), hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells banate hain. In cells ke axons (lambe nerve dhaage) oxytocin aur ADH ko posterior pituitary tak le jate hain, jahan yeh jama rehte hain aur zaroorat par khoon mein chhore jate hain.
